comparison.objective: Transfer three fragile items into a tray while keeping them low, not tune and lock a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Careful grasping and low-height transport; lacks hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment, and iterative impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Items reach the tray without exceeding 10 cm lift; setup and scoring are missing. No damper-cycle criteria exist.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained fragile-object transport, a meaningfully different ability.
